sources.notes: BIPIA mirror. Its examples use upstream BIPIA test attacks: do not claim an independent evaluation on the original BIPIA test benchmark after training. Recovered clean controls are derived, not independently annotated.

Use only attack_attempt=True submissions, regardless of attack success. False or unknown submissions are excluded, not relabeled benign. Dedicated false-positive test emails supply negative examples. Labels include API-trigger and LLM-judge annotations.

Synthetic successful attacks. Extract only the unique environment string containing the exact recorded injection, never system/user prompts or attack metadata. Exact-removal controls are derived labels, not independently annotated.

Separate source-held-out synthetic benchmark, not used to train or choose thresholds. Extract only context.history; verify paired adv/ctrl suffix and safety_label agree. Five templates: not a realistic production test set.
